Displayed values add observation noise; the sharp range brackets the latent value.
DO_NOT_EXPOSE: authoring_latent must never be read by bots, the UI, or 'Read the market'. Runtime reads only series[].displayed, .arrow and .sharp.
neutral_tolerance: +-12 (structural drift: halving, efficiency trend, grid retirements)

trigger.title: Compute Is Strategic
trigger.narrative: In July 2028, after two consecutive quarters in which reported AI revenue outgrows capex, a federal order designates large AI compute campuses as critical infrastructure: it pre-empts local permitting on designated sites, fast-tracks interconnection for approved projects and opens a nuclear-licensing track. Frontier labs raise again at higher valuations, spot GPU prices climb despite new supply, and every energized megawatt becomes a scarce asset. Protests reach their highest intensity yet, over bills, water and land.

decoy.reason: An open-weights model matches frontier quality at about one-eighth the serving cost. Token prices fall sharply for six weeks. Usage then explodes (Jevons): new products launch, labs re-invest the savings in bigger runs, and compute demand ends the quarter higher, not lower.
decoy.tell: Efficiency jumps but the Revenue Gap keeps narrowing, chip lead times keep lengthening and spot rents keep rising - the savings are being spent, not banked.
decoy.fair_in_hindsight: The efficiency jump was genuine and sizeable, the same kind of move that triggers S3. What differed was the demand response, visible in three other indicators.
